text_block_list.text:
I arrived at the training course
for a training session with Vodka.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! I ate plenty on my day off
and slept like a log.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Plus, I got to catch up on all those back issues of motorcycle magazines that had piled up.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Stamina's topped off, fired up and ready!
I'm totally set to tear up the track!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I'm going full throttle right from the start dash to knock their socks off!!
